name: @brooswit/butchr
description: The software factory: watches your Jira, runs herdr agents on active tickets, pushes updates to them over MCP

scripts.test:unit: bun test test/unit test/load && bun run scripts/coverage/gate.ts
scripts.check: bun run scripts/preflight.ts && bun run generate && bun run typecheck && bun test test/unit test/load && bun run scripts/coverage/gate.ts && bun run scripts/verify-generated-is-committed.ts && bun run build
scripts.build: bun build src/daemon/index.ts --outfile dist/butchr.js --target bun && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bun\n' | cat - dist/butchr.js > dist/butchr.tmp && mv dist/butchr.tmp dist/butchr.js && chmod +x dist/butchr.js
